title: ASEERE FAUJE SITAM QAIDIYE MEHAN ZAINAB
body:
Hai jiska Ayat eTat'heer Pairahan Zainab
Imamato'n ki Madadgaar khasta Tann Zainab
Hai Shaane Deene Khuda Jaane Panjatan Zainab
Ali ki Jaayi hai Abbas ki Bahan Zainab
<<MINI>>
Aseere Fauje sitam Qaidiye Mehan Zainab
<<DIVIDER>>
Wo waate Asr wo maqtal wo sogwaar Fazaa
Nazar ke saamne Bhai ka katt raha tha gala
Tadap Raha tha Badan zere tegh Pyaase ka
Udhar thi mehwe fughaa'n Shah ki Bahan Zainab
<<MINI>>
Aseere Fauje sitam Qaidiye Mehan Zainab
<<DIVIDER>>
Chhuta hai Bhai bhi aur marchuke hain Bachhe bhi
Rida bhi Sar pa nahi'n jal chuke hain khaime bhi
Jale hain qalb bhi daaman bhi aur kurte bhi
Chali hai chhor ke Bhai ko bekafan Zainab
<<MINI>>
Aseere Fauje sitam Qaidiye Mehan Zainab
<<DIVIDER>>
Jawa'n ka qatl to khud Uske Dil pa bhaala tha
Tha Gham Azeem to Shabbir ko sambhaala tha
Qadam jo khaime se pehle pahal nikaala tha
Sahara dene ko aayi thi pur mehan Zainab
<<MINI>>
Aseere Fauje sitam Qaidiye Mehan Zainab
<<DIVIDER>>
Dayaar e Kufa me taqreer se jihad kiya
Diya hai shaam ke darbaar me kabhi khutba
Kabhi khamoshi se mazloomiyat ko nashr kiya
Kabhi Ali Kabhi Zehra Kabhi Hasan Zainab
<<MINI>>
Aseere Fauje sitam Qaidiye Mehan Zainab
<<DIVIDER>>
Khayaal Kunbe ka tha Ro saki na jee bhar ke
Nikalne paaye na armaan Binte Haidar ke
Tha ek qalbe hazee'n daagh the Bahattar ke
Lahad me Le Gayi zakhmo'n ka ye chaman Zainab
<<MINI>>
Aseere Fauje sitam Qaidiye Mehan Zainab
<<DIVIDER>>
Qanaat thaam le'n ye Akbare Jawa'n se kaho
Sahara dene ko Aye Saaniye Ali Utho
Bahan ko Aye Shahe Bekas Tumhi sawaar karo
Chali hai Karbobala se suwe Watan Zainab
<<MINI>>
Aseere Fauje sitam Qaidiye Mehan Zainab
author: Ali Jaweed Maqsood
